name: Pharmco Industries Inc
old_description: Locally owned and operated, Pharmco is a full-service feed, seed, animal health, farming and ranching equipment provider serving the Midwest. When you need expert advice, products, and services that’ll make your operation successful, look to Pharmco.
about:
Pharmco Industries Inc operates from its headquarters in Chamberlain, South Dakota, with additional locations in Platte, Winner, and Kimball. The company is locally owned and operated, though its founding year and founders are not publicly disclosed. It began as a full-service provider of feed, seed, animal health products, and farming and ranching equipment to agricultural operations across the Midwest.

The business distributes a range of agricultural inputs — including feed, seed, and animal health supplies — and supplies farming and ranching equipment from established manufacturers. Its service portfolio covers feed ration formulation, nutrition consulting, livestock management recommendations, alternative feed sourcing, byproduct evaluation, feedlot profitability analysis, cattle record keeping and billing for custom feedlots, and regular visual herd inspections. The company also leverages industry connections to link customers with feedstuffs, cattle brokers, and other market representatives.

Pharmco serves livestock producers, crop farmers, and custom feed yards throughout the Midwest. Its customer base includes cattle feeding operations that rely on the firm’s nutrition expertise, record-keeping services, and market connections to manage herd performance and marketing decisions.

The company emphasizes its local ownership and territory-specific service model, highlighting an experienced team with deep knowledge of the livestock and seed sectors. It positions its differentiators as customer relationships, extensive industry connections, and a commitment to supplying quality products from reputable manufacturers.

name: Phoenix Cable Inc
old_description: Phoenix Cable, Inc (PCI) is a privately owned manufacturer of cable and harness assemblies. We have been in business for over 28 years. We can take your supplied assembly and reverse engineer at no cost or build from a drawing to a workable first article.
about:
Phoenix Cable, Inc. (PCI) was founded in 1994 as a family-owned business in Phoenix, Arizona. The privately held company began as a local manufacturer of cable and wire harness assemblies and has since expanded its reach to serve customers globally.

PCI specializes in custom cable and wire harness assemblies, offering services that include automated wire preparation and crimping, custom cable labeling with Brady™ labels, reverse engineering of existing assemblies at no cost, and 100% inspection and testing to IPC/WHMA-A-620 standards. The company stocks a range of UL-style hook-up wire, jacketed cable from 1 to 60 pairs, coaxial cables (RG174 to RG217), flat ribbon cables, and Hi-Flex IGUS™/LAPP™ products, along with common connectors and contacts.

The company serves industries such as semiconductor, telecommunications, electronics, industrial, commercial, medical, and instrumentation. PCI has focused on semiconductor assemblies for the past 20 years, providing OEM-equivalent and custom assemblies for original equipment manufacturers and other clients worldwide.

PCI differentiates itself through reverse engineering at no charge, claimed shortest lead times in the industry, blind drop-shipping globally, and a quality system certified to ISO 9001:2015 with assemblers certified to IPC/WHMA-A-620. Membership in the Wiring Harness Manufacturers Association (WHMA) further underscores its commitment to industry standards.

name: Phoenix-Lamar Corporation
old_description: Austin, Texas-based contract manufacturer of custom molded cable assemblies, electrical cables, and wire harnesses serving industrial, medical, and telecom clients.
about:
Phoenix-Lamar Corporation was founded in 1972 by Maitland Huffman in Austin, Texas. Huffman, an electronics enthusiast with multiple degrees, established the company as a family-oriented business focused on custom cable and wire harness manufacturing.

The company specializes in custom molded cable assemblies, electrical cables, and wire harnesses, offering in-house design, engineering, prototyping, injection molding, and turnkey assembly. Its production ranges from simple motherboard jumpers to complex 12-mile control cables, with every assembly undergoing 100% electrical testing.

Phoenix-Lamar serves industries including computer and electronics manufacturers, telecommunications, medical diagnostics, biomedical, instrumentation, traffic control, environmental testing, and contract manufacturers. Notable clients include National Instruments, which named the company Supplier of the Year.

The company emphasizes near-zero non-conforming assemblies, UL approval, and a quality system that separates inspection from production to ensure objectivity. Its culture stresses early deliveries, precision workmanship, and long-term employee retention, with many staff members staying for decades.

name: Piedmont Food Processing Center
old_description: FROM FIRST TIME FOOD ENTREPRENEURS TO EXPERIENCED FOOD INDUSTRY PROFESSIONALS
about:
Piedmont Food Processing Center operates in Hillsborough, North Carolina. Founded in 2018 as a North Carolina non‑profit, the organization grew out of a shared‑kitchen facility established in 2011 through a joint project of Alamance, Chatham, Durham, and Orange counties. The center provides management services to shared‑use kitchens across the state.

The Hillsborough site houses four commercial kitchens that are rented exclusively to one client at a time, with 24‑hour, seven‑day‑a‑week access. The facility also offers dry, refrigerated, and frozen storage that meets Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) standards. Since opening, the incubator has served roughly 500 food businesses, currently supports about 75 clients, and is credited with generating 180 jobs and more than $3 million in annual retail value each year.

Clients range from first‑time entrepreneurs to established professionals producing packaged foods, running catering and meal‑prep operations, or launching food trucks. The center works closely with regulatory bodies including the NCDA, Orange County Health Department, USDA, FDA, OSHA, and the Department of Homeland Security to help clients navigate compliance.

The organization emphasizes a low‑risk entry model: no annual fees or contracts, exclusive kitchen use during reserved blocks, and hands‑on business development support. It also highlights a focus on women food entrepreneurs and a community of approachable expertise that helps clients move from concept to market.

name: Pine Crafter Furniture
old_description: Discover timeless craftsmanship and quality at Pine Crafter Furniture. As a family owned and operated furniture manufacturing company since 1983, we specialize in bunk beds, captain beds, case goods, and more. Explore our exquisite collection today!
about:
Pine Crafter Furniture has been a family-owned and operated manufacturer in Haleyville, Alabama since 1983. The company was founded as a furniture manufacturing business specializing in solid pine wood products, though the names of the original founders are not publicly disclosed.

The company produces bunk beds, captain beds, case goods, and related bedroom furniture, with a focus on solid pine wood construction. Its product range includes children’s bunk beds, adult bunk beds, staircase bunk beds, conversion kits, underbed storage units, and desk-and-chair sets. Operations have historically included both domestic and Brazilian-sourced lines, though the domestic line is being discontinued and Brazilian inventory is being cleared. The firm is now shifting its focus to the Furniture Dash product line, with new bunk bed styles and collections planned.

Pine Crafter sells through furniture stores and distributors across the United States, serving the residential furniture retail and wholesale channels. Its customer base includes independent furniture retailers and larger distributors who stock the company’s bunk beds and case goods.

The company emphasizes quality, affordability, and prompt delivery as its distinguishing attributes, positioning itself as a provider of solid pine wood bunk beds in the U.S. market. The transition to the Furniture Dash line reflects an effort to refresh the product portfolio while maintaining the family-owned operational ethos.

Piston Automotive operates from Marion, Ohio, where it was founded by former NBA player Vinnie Johnson. Johnson established the business with a focus on assembly systems, building a culture that sweats the details and honors every promise.

The company provides advanced assembly and manufacturing services backed by process engineering, design and development, and product design and prototype testing. Its capabilities span vehicle systems including electrical and battery, powertrain and cooling, interior, exterior, and chassis. Piston Automotive also offers total solution and supply chain management, handling customer requirements analysis, assembly process conceptualization, design verification, product-level testing, and production validation trials. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

Piston Automotive serves the automotive industry, working with manufacturers on vehicle electrification and traditional powertrain programs. Its customer base includes OEMs and tier suppliers seeking a partner for complex assembly and process-driven solutions across multiple vehicle platforms.

The company differentiates itself through a process-driven philosophy summarized as "Our process is our product." It claims a national reputation for product and process excellence, positioning itself as a partner rather than a supplier, adding value at every stage from concept through production. Continuous improvement in knowledge, capabilities, and quality is stated as a core commitment.
